glossary.definition: (A) "Intermediate holding company" means a stock corporation that owns all of the shares of voting stock of one or more reorganized stock companies after a reorganization under sections 3913.25 to 3913.38 of the Revised Code. "Intermediate holding company" also means a stock corporation that is the parent or subsidiary of another intermediate holding company.
glossary.scope: As used in sections 3913.25 to 3913.38 of the Revised Code:
glossary.source_title: Section 3913.25 - Reorganization of mutual insurance company as stock insurance company definitions.

glossary.definition: (B) "Mutual insurance company" means a domestic or foreign mutual life insurance company or a domestic or foreign mutual insurance company other than a mutual life insurance company.
glossary.scope: As used in sections 3913.25 to 3913.38 of the Revised Code:
glossary.source_title: Section 3913.25 - Reorganization of mutual insurance company as stock insurance company definitions.

glossary.definition: (C) "Mutual insurance holding company" means a domestic mutual insurance holding company incorporated pursuant to a reorganization plan adopted under sections 3913.26 to 3913.28 of the Revised Code, which company is the parent company of a reorganized stock company or of an intermediate holding company.
glossary.scope: As used in sections 3913.25 to 3913.38 of the Revised Code:
glossary.source_title: Section 3913.25 - Reorganization of mutual insurance company as stock insurance company definitions.

glossary.definition: (D) "Policyholder" has the same meaning as in section 3913.10 of the Revised Code when used with respect to a life insurance company, and has the same meaning as in section 3913.20 of the Revised Code when used with respect to an insurance company other than a life insurance company.
glossary.scope: As used in sections 3913.25 to 3913.38 of the Revised Code:
glossary.source_title: Section 3913.25 - Reorganization of mutual insurance company as stock insurance company definitions.

glossary.definition: (E) "Reorganization plan" means a reorganization plan adopted by a mutual insurance company's board of directors in accordance with section 3913.26 of the Revised Code.
glossary.scope: As used in sections 3913.25 to 3913.38 of the Revised Code:
glossary.source_title: Section 3913.25 - Reorganization of mutual insurance company as stock insurance company definitions.

glossary.definition: (F) "Reorganized stock company" means the domestic or foreign stock insurance company resulting from a domestic or foreign mutual insurance company's reorganization under sections 3913.25 to 3913.38 of the Revised Code.
glossary.scope: As used in sections 3913.25 to 3913.38 of the Revised Code:
glossary.source_title: Section 3913.25 - Reorganization of mutual insurance company as stock insurance company definitions.

glossary.definition: (G) "Voting stock" means securities of any class or any ownership interest having voting power for the election of directors, trustees, or management of a person, other than securities having voting power only as a result of the occurrence of a contingency.
glossary.scope: As used in sections 3913.25 to 3913.38 of the Revised Code:
glossary.source_title: Section 3913.25 - Reorganization of mutual insurance company as stock insurance company definitions.
